cards.title: NVIDIA Corporation Data Center Total Revenues (Quarterly)
cards.description: NVIDIA Corporation Data Center Total Revenues (Normalized) (Quarterly)'s latest value was $75,246,000,000 in Apr 2026, up 7,673.3% since Jan 2020.

metric_definitions.name: Total Revenues (Normalized)
metric_definitions.definition: Revenue the company reported for this segment, as disclosed in its segment note. The figure covers one segment only, so it does not sum to consolidated total revenue unless the company reports no other segment.

sources.source_description: Fiscal.ai standardizes reported financials from company filings into comparable line items. Segment figures are taken from each company's segment note and normalized so the same line item is comparable across companies and periods.
